messages:
Maria R.: FYI — billing policy update going live next week (May 6). Key changes: soft rate limits, a 7-day overage grace window, and consolidated monthly invoice exports. Full doc link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing-policy :loudspeaker:
Finance Bot: New billing doc published: https://redwood.example.com/internal/billing-policy (PDF + CSV schema)
Sam K.: quick q — what do you mean by soft rate limits? will requests be throttled or rejected?
Maria R.: Soft limits = 429s only after sustained spikes; for most customers we'll apply a dynamic throttling step-down first. Only enforce hard rejects if rate stays above threshold for >5m. Thresholds depend on plan (self-serve vs reserved).
Ashley L.: for Dedicated customers, do we invoice for estimated overages or do we keep current reserved model?
Maria R.: Dedicated stays the same for committed capacity. Overage grace applies to hosted API customers on metered plans. We'll post a migration guide for Dedicated teams who want to switch to metered bursting.
Ryan T.: CSV format for invoices — can we get an example header? need this for our accounting export job.
Maria R.: sure — sample header: `invoice_id,customer_id,period_start,period_end,total_amount,token_count,embedding_units,overage_amount,credits_applied` I'll paste full example in the doc.
Tara P.: tagging eng-platform — can we surface the new rate-limit headers in the SDK? X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit / X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining would be great.
Eng-Oncall Bot: @eng-platform could you please review rate-limit header rollout? PR checklist: update client libs, add tests, and include examples in SDK docs.
Sam K.: and how about free credits? are we changing expiry?
Maria R.: Free trial credits will now expire 90 days after issuance (was 180). We found long-lived credits cause billing surprises. We'll grandfather credits issued before May 6.
Ashley L.: we'll need a customer-facing email + changelog entry. Recommended wording?
Maria R.: Draft is in #marketing-drafts, Slack thread pinned in the doc. TL;DR: "We're updating limits and billing exports to improve predictability; no immediate charges during the 7-day grace period; detailed FAQ and migration steps included."
Ryan T.: any SLA impact?
Maria R.: No SLA changes. We're clarifying behavior under transient overloads to avoid unexpected hard rejects.
Sam K.: thanks. last q — will overage charges show up on the same invoice or separate line items?
Maria R.: Same invoice. Overage line item appears if used during the billing period; credits applied after calculating total. Examples in the CSV.
Tara P.: I'll open an eng PR to add headers + client retry guidance.
Maria R.: Great — timeline: doc live now, SDK updates targeted by May 3, policy effective May 6. AMA session with Finance + Eng next Wed 14:00 PT in #town-hall.
Ashley L.: :thumbsup: putting the customer emails on a schedule now.
Sam K.: :raised_hands: appreciate the clarity
Maria R.: Thanks all — please read the doc and drop questions in the AMA or here.
